title: Bob Sutton publishes his original Incorruptible blurb — 'destroys the myth that only sleazy founders and companies get rich'
summary: On launch day, Bob Sutton — Stanford organizational psychologist, NYT bestselling author of The No Asshole Rule and Good Boss, Bad Boss — shares the full, untrimmed version of his back-of-book blurb. The publisher cut it down; Sutton publishes the original on LinkedIn.
blockquote: Incorruptible destroys the myth that only sleazy founders and companies get rich. Eric Ries shows you how to build a mission-driven company that will be humane, ethical, and make piles of money for decades. And Eric's charm, wonderful writing, and warm wisdom make this book a rare joy to read.
attribution_title: Stanford professor; NYT bestselling author of The No Asshole Rule and Good Boss, Bad Boss
